Help me pick a laptop under 80,000 rupees for programming
10:36 PM

For programming under ₹80,000 aim for 16 GB RAM, a 512 GB SSD and a recent mid-range processor. Those matter far more than a fancy graphics card.

Memory: 16 GB minimum. 8 GB struggles once you run an editor, a browser and Docker together.
Processor: Ryzen 5 or 7 (7000 series or newer), Intel Core i5 (13th generation or newer), or Core Ultra 5.
Storage: 512 GB SSD, ideally with a free slot for an upgrade.
Screen and keyboard: 14 or 15 inch, full HD IPS, at least 300 nits, with a comfortable keyboard.
Battery: around 50 Wh or more, since you will code away from a socket.
Graphics card: only needed for machine learning or games. Skip it otherwise and save money.

If you like macOS, a MacBook Air with an M-series chip is a strong choice, but at this budget you may need a deal or an older version. Prices change daily, so I haven't quoted any.

Do you want me to check current listings for 3 options? Tell me which system you prefer (Windows, Mac or Linux) and what you mostly code in.
